question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Cordial
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. **Friendly**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"cordial"** means warm and friendly. (सौहार्दपूर्ण)
 
 
• **Example: **The host was very cordial, making sure all guests felt welcome.
 
 
 
• **"Friendly"** refers to someone who is kind and pleasant. (मित्रवत)
 
 
• **Example: **She has a friendly smile that makes everyone feel at ease.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'cordial'** is **'friendly'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Friendly**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Unfriendly** (अमित्र): Not friendly or kind.
 
 
• **Example:** His unfriendly attitude made it hard to approach him.
 
 
 
• **Brave** (बहादुर): Ready to face and endure danger or pain; showing courage.
 
 
• **Example:** The brave firefighter saved the child from the burning building.
 
 
 
• **Aromatic** (सुगंधित): Having a pleasant and distinctive smell.
 
 
• **Example:** The aromatic spices filled the kitchen with a delightful scent.
